    {

      "confidence": 0.8,
      "evidence": [
        "ae_death_by_year.csv: AE peaks at 1.150 (2018) and 1.102 (2019) before reverting to ~1.0 in 2020.",

      ],
      "recommended_action": "Investigate 2018-2019 claim processing, coding changes, or exposure base accuracy. If valid, adjust pricing trend; if data error, correct and re-run analysis."
    },
    {
      "benefit": "CI",
      "years": [2018, 2019],
      "pattern": "shock",
      "direction": "increase",
      "magnitude": "~+10% vs baseline (~3.1 to 3.6 sigma)",
      "confidence": 0.85,
      "evidence": [
        "ae_ci_by_year.csv: AE peaks at 1.099 (2018) and 1.108 (2019), then drops to 0.985 in 2020.",
        "Consistent timing with Death line; magnitude well above Poisson null (1/sqrt(E) ~0.03)."
      ],
      "recommended_action": "Verify CI benefit definitions and reporting protocols for 2018. Check for systematic over-reporting or exposure undercount. Update assumptions if shock reflects genuine experience hardening."
    },
    {
      "benefit": "IP",
      "years": [2016, 2024],
      "pattern": "volatility",
      "direction": "dispersion",
      "magnitude": "Empirical SD ~0.045 vs Poisson ~0.026 (70% overdispersion)",
      "confidence": 0.75,
      "evidence": [
        "ae_ip_by_year.csv: alternating highs (1.025-1.084, 2016-2019) and lows (0.935-0.978, 2020-2024) with overall AE 1.002.",
        "Year-to-year dispersion materially exceeds 1/sqrt(E) expectation, invalidating Poisson null."
      ],
      "recommended_action": "Switch to overdispersed model (e.g., beta-binomial) for IP pricing/valuation. Investigate mix or duration effects causing annual fluctuation. Do not flag individual years as outliers."
    }
  ]
}
